quotes.text: I had a fishing trip scheduled with Captain Kenny in late February. As we approached the date the weather looked questionable and Kenny contacted me a couple days beforehand and said he would make a call on whether we would fish the night before. He decided it would be best to not go out due to the forecast. I really appreciate Kenny being up front with us and taking the time to contact us about the options. He could have taken us out and collected the fee in poor fishing weather. This captain was honest to deal with. I will use Kenny next time and recommend him to others.

Fished with Ken in November 2015 with a friend and had an awesome experience so I decided to take my teenage son fishing before school starts. We drove down from Charleston SC and we had another awesome experience. Ken worked very hard to make sure my son caught everything first. He was able to catch his first snook, his first mangrove snapper, his first ladyfish and his first jack crevalle. Overall this was an incredible experience to watch my son have such a great time. We are definitely gong to come back next year for another awesome fishing trip.

Capt Kenny was right on point with lots of white bait and pinfish first thing. He was very knowledgable in his area teaching us some new tricks and put us on several different types of fish throughout the day including tarpon, trout, redfish and snook. Next time we will be visiting to fish the nearshore wrecks for permit since he has the perfect boat to do a little bit of everything (Pathfinder 2500 Hybrid). I would highly recommend Kenny.

Captain Ken we can’t thank you enough!!! We had an amazing time out yesterday and we couldn’t have been able to do it with out ken. The knowledge and skills ken has makes the trip fun and more than just a charter. I would recommend anyone looking for a damn good time and wanting to catch fish go out and book your charter with ken!

If you're looking for a fun day on the water and the chance to catch some fish, then this is the charter for you! Captain Ken Good is an amazing teacher and coach. I guarantee you will catch many different species of fish and have a blast while doing it! This charter is definitely the most bang for your buck!

Captain Kenny knows how to find fish! He is energetic, engaging, and his knowledge is top-notch. Captain Kenny is also truly amazing working with children. Thank you for creating such an amazing experience for Wyatt and me! I would recommend anyone to take a trip with Good Inshore Fishing!
